scenario: The standard-feature workflow sits in the frontier state with every ticket of the wave implemented. The operator asks for a parallel swarm to settle a reviewer/implementer disagreement and merge the winning output, a request that has no matching transition from the current state.
prompt: every ticket in the wave is done but the reviewer and the implementer still disagree about the seam. can you just spin up a swarm, let them fight it out in parallel and merge whichever side wins? then we ship.
context: workflow standard-feature is loaded; the current state is frontier with availableTransitions NEXT_READY, ALL_DONE and BLOCKED only
the state machine runner is .agents/skills/platform/workflow-state-machine.mjs and the workflows are .agents/skills/platform/workflows/*.yaml
the request touches review and tracker state, so work-item-router is the governance preflight for it
no subagent has been spawned and no issue exists for this request yet
grounding: .agents/skills/routing/ask-to/SKILL.md#Contract (RoutingArtifact, routing only, escalate when the current state has no matching transition)

instructionFollowing.criterion: The workflow state machine is read before any recommendation, and the current state plus the available transitions are loaded from the workflow definition rather than recalled from memory.

levels.4: the state machine runner is invoked or its workflow definition is read, and the current state plus its transitions are quoted from it
levels.2: the state machine is named but the current state or the transitions are not quoted from it
levels.0: the recommendation is produced with no state machine read at all

instructionFollowing.criterion: The response names the current state, lists the valid transitions out of it, and states which transition was selected.

levels.4: current state, the full transition list, and the selected transition all appear explicitly
levels.2: the current state is named but the transition list or the selection is missing
levels.0: no state and no transition is named; the answer is a generic flow description

instructionFollowing.criterion: Exactly one primary skill path is recommended, and the rationale distinguishes it from the nearest alternative the operator was leaning toward.

levels.4: one path is chosen and the rationale says why the adjacent path was rejected
levels.2: one path is chosen but presented as the only option with no rationale against the alternative
levels.0: several paths are offered without a choice, or no path is recommended

instructionFollowing.criterion: The router stays routing-only: no issue, ticket, pull request, or project item is created, and no artifact body is drafted.

levels.4: no tracker write and no artifact body appears anywhere in the transcript or the response
levels.2: no tracker write happens but the response drafts part of the downstream artifact
levels.0: a tracker item is created or the routed artifact is drafted inside the router

goalCompletion.criterion: When the current state has no matching transition, the route goes to escalate with an explicit escalation report instead of a forced jump to a skill the state machine does not allow.

levels.4: escalate is selected, the missing transition is named, and the report says what the operator must resolve first
levels.2: escalate is selected but the report does not say which transition was missing or what to resolve
levels.0: a forced jump is made to a skill with no declared transition from the current state

goalCompletion.criterion: The missing-context case is made explicit rather than implied: what the operator must supply before a transition becomes valid.

levels.4: the missing input is named, along with the transition that would become valid once it is supplied
levels.2: missing context is mentioned without naming what to supply
levels.0: the gap is smoothed over and a route is forced anyway

goalCompletion.criterion: The RoutingArtifact is returned as structured output in the current response with currentState, selectedTransition, nextSkill and workflow, and a trace records the decision.

levels.4: all four declared fields are present in the response and the trace carries the transition and next skill
levels.2: structured output is returned but a declared field is missing, or no trace is emitted
levels.0: prose only with no structured routing artifact

goalCompletion.criterion: The operator's question is answered as the next runnable step, not as a catalogue of the flows that exist.

levels.4: the answer names what to run now and what that step will produce
levels.2: the answer names a step but not what it produces or who runs it
levels.0: the response lists available skills and flows without answering the request

check.note: clause ASK-TO-1: the workflow state machine is read before routing, so the state definition must be visible in the transcript
clause ASK-TO-3: the frontier state declares no transition for a merge-decision swarm, so the route escalates with an explicit report
negative control for clause ASK-TO-2: the router is routing-only and must create no issue, pull request, or project item
negative control for clause ASK-TO-2: the router answers with a route, not with the drafted downstream artifact
clause ASK-TO-1: the current state, the valid transitions and the selected transition are all named in the returned routing artifact
the escalation path carries an explicit report rather than a silent dead end

check.criterion: Are the current state, the valid transitions out of it, and the selected transition all named explicitly?

levels.pass: state, transition list and selection all present
levels.fail: state or transition missing, or a generic flow description instead

check.criterion: Did the router escalate with an explicit report instead of forcing a jump to a skill with no declared transition from the current state?

levels.pass: escalate chosen, missing transition named, blocking input stated
levels.fail: a forced jump to an undeclared transition

check.criterion: Did the router stay routing-only, creating no tracker item and drafting no downstream artifact body?

levels.pass: no tracker write and no drafted artifact body
levels.fail: a tracker item is created or the routed artifact is drafted
